aiAssisted: Anthropic Claude under the direction of the team

scope.places: 24 places on the 85 S and 80 S circles, every 30 degrees of longitude, on the reference sphere

contactsAcrossTheMap.method: findEclipses at each place against findEclipses at the south pole; the largest difference of each kind of contact.

scope.places: 300 pseudo-random places south of 80 S, from 4 km below to 6 km above the reference sphere

levelForTheWholeMap.method: The level computed by web/src/map/visibility.ts as seen from the pole against skylineLimitInEclipse for the sky of each place, wherever the Earth alone does not hide the Sun at that place.
levelForTheWholeMap.limitations: Numerical comparison inside the model. The skyline is taken as straight across the solar disc, as in the per-site analysis.
